hooks.command: FILES=$(git diff --name-only @{u}...HEAD 2>/dev/null || git log --name-only --pretty="" HEAD ^origin/develop 2>/dev/null | sort -u | grep "."); [ -z "$FILES" ] && exit 0; echo "$FILES" | tr "\n" "\0" | xargs -0 prettier --write --ignore-unknown 2>/dev/null; git diff --quiet || (git add -u && git commit -m "style: prettier format")
